palette: limestone terrace ground + heavy stone-block panels + chisel-gold marks + crimson level lines + graphite ink
typography: graphite headings on limestone plaques, dark terrace label tabs with gold left bar, crimson stamps reserved for exam verdicts, gold chips for superlatives, thin ink underline for tests
composition: the three superlatives sit as a stone bench of content-effect-procedure blocks; the charter scene sets two quotation plaques on a reading plinth; the boundary scene draws a written-unwritten divide beside a fundamentals block rail
surface: flat limestone ground with faint block-joint hairlines, stone panels with hairline weathered borders and corner chisel dots, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: stone blocks settle onto the terrace one by one, level lines draw across, quotation plaques rise onto the plinth, the boundary wall fills brick by brick
transition: a chisel tap sounds and the terrace clears for the next course
